old_caption:
The video captures a young woman practicing dance moves in a spacious studio with mirrored walls. She is dressed in a black crop top, white shorts, and white sneakers, with her hair tied back in a ponytail. The studio features a ballet barre along one wall and a door with a decorative piece on it. The lighting is bright, illuminating the reflective surfaces and creating a clean, professional atmosphere.

She begins in a wide stance, facing the mirror with her hands clasped near her chest. She moves rhythmically, stepping side to side while performing arm movements. Her actions include a repetitive side-to-side motion and arm gestures, and she maintains a consistent posture. The camera remains static. This perspective allows viewers to see both her direct movements and their mirrored counterparts, emphasizing the symmetry and her focused practice.

caption:
The video captures a woman in a dance studio facing a wall of mirrors, her back to the camera so her front appears as a reflection. She wears a black crop top, white shorts, white sneakers and a pink face mask, her hair in a ponytail, while ballet barres, string lights and a smartphone on the floor fill the fixed background. She stands wide with hands clasped at her chest, already swaying her torso and hips side to side.

As the routine continues, the heel of her left foot lifts while her weight shifts, then re-plants, the motion reproduced in the reflection. A moment later her right heel rises and her ponytail swings to the side as her upper body turns. Her feet then draw closer together and her body rotates again, hair swinging. The wide stance returns, hands still clasped at her chest.

Toward the end of the visible segment she leans forward and extends her left leg outward and backward in a controlled kick-like gesture. She retracts it to the planted wide stance, the reflection tracking every shift.
